segments.he: בְּעֶשְׂרִים וְתִשְׁעָה בְּאָב וְכוּ׳. בֶּן עַזַּאי לְטַעְמֵיהּ, דְּאָמַר: הָאֱלוּלִין מִתְעַשְּׂרִין בִּפְנֵי עַצְמָן.
segments.en: The mishna teaches that ben Azzai says the last gathering time is «on the twenty-ninth of Av,» rather than fifteen days before Sukkot. The Gemara notes that «ben Azzai» conforms «to his» standard line of «reasoning, as he said: The» animals born «in Elul are tithed by themselves,» because it is uncertain whether the new year for animal tithes begins on the first of Tishrei or the first of Elul. Consequently, he sets the time for animal tithe before the beginning of Elul to avoid the possibility of tithing animals born in one year with animals born in the next year.
